A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same GraphEval research work. The complete main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A-H are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original experiments on ICLR Papers and AI Researcher in Tables 2-3, novelty-assessment results in Figure 4, and additional empirical evaluations in Appendices E-H.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results, including the main benchmark comparisons, novelty assessment, and appendix evaluations.

M1.justification: Viewpoint-graph construction, label propagation, the weighted GNN, and the novelty-assessment mechanism in Sections 3-5 are unchanged. The method-name spelling corrections do not alter any procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same ICLR Papers, AI Researcher, FActScore factual-verification, and ASAP-Review data. Synthetic plagiarism tests and temporal-generalization scenarios are also retained unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 2-3 retain Prompted LLM, CoT, CoT-SC, ToT, Research Agent, and fine-tuned BERT. Comparator membership in the appendix experiments, including the lightweight GNN and Hybrid comparisons, is unchanged.

E3.justification: Section 6 and the appendices preserve the same splits, label mappings, model sizes, training budgets, metrics, and testing procedures. These include the 300/50 ICLR training/test sample counts and the AI Researcher 85%/15% split.

E4.justification: The novelty-assessment ablation in Figure 4, temporal-generalization test in Appendix E.2, architecture and relation-extraction comparisons in Appendix F, and viewpoint-accuracy analyses in Appendix H are unchanged.

E5.justification: Appendix C retains the same statement about averaging multiple AI Researcher experiments. No run counts, seed information, uncertainty estimates, or statistical tests are added or revised.

E6.justification: Numerical results and reported findings match throughout the main text and appendices. For example, GraphEval-GNN retains macro F1 scores of 43.59% on ICLR Papers and 67.13% on AI Researcher in Tables 2-3.

T1.justification: The problem formulation, graph definitions, and equations (1)-(4) are unchanged. Neither version introduces different assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about graph-based idea evaluation, lightweight computation, improved evaluation performance, and plagiarism detection.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning prompt sensitivity, viewpoint-graph benefits, computational tradeoffs, generalization, and viewpoint fidelity are unchanged. No substantive qualification or limitation is added or removed.

D1.justification: The implementation details, hardware, prompts, hyperparameters, dataset-processing descriptions, and code-access information remain unchanged in Section 6 and the appendices.

R1.justification: The cited works, bibliography, related-work discussion, and positioning of GraphEval as a graph-based approach to idea evaluation are unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 corrects six occurrences of 'GraghEval' to 'GraphEval' in Tables 2-3 and Section 7.1, and updates the first-page arXiv version/date stamp. The remaining prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Tables 2-3 have corrected method labels and slight spacing changes, while the first-page arXiv stamp is updated and repositioned. Figures, captions, table organization, and appendix layouts otherwise remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 provides slight editorial polish by correcting obvious method-name typos. The scientific content, supporting evidence, explanations, and reproducibility information are unchanged, including all appendices. These cosmetic corrections do not meaningfully alter the paper's overall quality.
